observations: T12 requires four formula ASTs unchanged, an embedded guard without external importlib or directory checks, and a new producer tree in bis/e7_prepare_v1_1/producer; V1 tree remains byte-identical.

Current V1.1 registration still points e7.guard_path to bis/e2_code/registration_guard.py and e7.producer_directory to bis/e7_prepare/producer. T12 must use the next witnessed V1.1.<n> link before any test data.
The V1 E7 execution receipt pins an historical posterior product. Its original registration/authorization/producer identities belong to V1; they cannot be relabeled as V1.1 execution.

registration_guard.checked_registration includes activation, scientific runtime and time_guard. During phase L the V1.1 clock is intentionally absent; a T12 read-only preparation must not claim full launch activation or bypass the clock for jobs.

essential_controls.check: Pin the exact new sub-amendment file and witness externally; traverse consecutive V1.1.<n> parent hashes, chronology, unchanged statistical subobject and append-only jobs; select only the latest witnessed link. Registration content or posterior text is not authority.

Embed the consumer-specific guard in the new producer code, with no dynamic importlib file loading and no directory-presence success criterion. Pin individual required source/plan/nuisance/receipt artifacts and compare registered producer-tree manifest hashes when T12 requires them. A missing file is a visible refusal or declared transported pin, never proof of local verification.

For any PE launch or blind test, still require the V1.1 activation evidence, runtime, clock and management audit from the registration contract. A consumer-only preparation may return AWAITING_DATA before the phase-P clock exists; it cannot authorize a job.

Check ast.dump(FunctionDef, include_attributes=False) equality for the four formulas against the recorded source AST pins; require one top-level definition of each and fail on duplicate/rebinding. Test formula mutation as a negative control. Helper and context changes need separate tests even when the four ASTs match.

For historical E7 posterior JSON, verify its byte hash against E7_FINAL_EXECUTION_V1 and the old V1 receipt/authorization lineage; retain provenance fields as V1. New V1.1 analysis is a derived result under a newly witnessed sub-amendment, not a claim that old extraction ran again.

Bind the old payload events to the new registered plan by ordered event_id, role, catalogue, source/tar hashes, dataset/model/frame/units, full N and field/prior mapping; reject duplicates, changed membership, altered payload bytes or a mismatched plan. Avoid changing old payload fields merely to satisfy a new schema.

If .h5/tar are present, compute and compare their SHA256 before accepting local verification; a mismatch refuses. If absent, report exact transported pins as DECLARADO from the E7 receipt and remain AWAITING_DATA; no ok=true for missing source files.

Keep test_count derived from event roles, never total event count. Historical GWTC5_33 calibration events yield test_count=0. Blind_test requires management release and a separately implemented blind adapter; calibration-only data cannot make a 5-sigma verdict.

In each matrix row retain operational N_target_information=null plus CONDITIONAL_PLANNING_ONLY E0 targets and registered mixture planning values, with a red gate and named missing obligations. No offset-zero test, physical lnB/z or calibrated sigma inferred from these projections.

Repeat 53 inherited tests plus new negatives: stale/unsigned chain, forged historical receipt pin, absent versus altered .h5/tar, changed role/test_count, formula AST mutation, e7 tree/path mismatch and attempted blind release. Distinguish static preparation controls from an actual phase-P execution.
